bagPolicy.summary: One clear plastic or vinyl bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, including a clear backpack, or one nonclear clutch up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches is permitted. Medical and child-accompanied diaper bags are inspected; no bag check is provided.
allowed: Clear bag or backpack up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Over 6,000 on-site spaces serve the complex; parking prices depend on the event, and payment is cashless. Lots open at least one hour before showtime.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Greensboro Complex parking page does not specify one official rideshare pickup point.

concessions.summary: Concession stands sell food and drinks and accept card payment only. Outside food and drinks are prohibited unless a special dietary need is arranged in advance.

accessibility.summary: Marked spaces near the Coliseum main entrance need a state-issued placard or plate and are subject to the regular parking fee. Accessible tickets are sold by the venue ticket office.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Tickets generally allow only one entry; exiting prevents re-entry unless a specific event announces an exception.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call opens two hours before ticketed events; show government ID and the purchasing credit card, with the same name on both. The Coliseum ticket office opens at noon on arena event days.
